source: Mongo bookstore.feedback, rows sent from the feedback button on the site
method: Each report gets the first theme whose rule matches: the widget’s own label at the start of the message (a translation request, translation feedback, a reading-guide request) or a keyword rule. No model reads the messages. Reports that match no theme (thanks, site bugs, book suggestions) are not counted.

themes.label: No English on the page
themes.paraphrase: A reader reached a page with a transcription but no English, or English for only part of it, and asked for it.
themes.did: Each request names one page. It is read in the feedback queue and the page is sent for translation.

themes.label: Asked for a guide or a summary
themes.paraphrase: A reader asked for a reading guide or a summary of the book they were reading.
themes.did: Summaries and reading guides exist for some books. Requests are recorded per book and answered one at a time.

themes.label: Wrong edition, author or date
themes.paraphrase: The catalogue named the wrong edition, author or year, or a reader asked whether a book is still in copyright.
themes.did: Each report is checked against the title page and the record corrected when it holds up.

themes.label: Garbled or invented transcription
themes.paraphrase: A transcription ran into a loop, used the wrong alphabet, wrote formulas instead of letters, or held far more text than the page.
themes.did: Reported pages are re-read one at a time. A check that finds garbled pages across the whole library is planned.

themes.label: Scan problems
themes.paraphrase: A two-page spread was not split, a scan was badly cropped or upside down, or the image was too small to read.
themes.did: Splitting and cropping are fixed book by book when reported. Trimming dark scanner borders across the library is under way.

themes.label: Notes mixed into the text
themes.paraphrase: Notes added in translation looked like the book’s own words, or switching notes off also hid the text.
themes.did: Single display faults were fixed in the reader. Notes are being rebuilt as a separate layer that a reader can switch off.

themes.label: The English says something the original does not
themes.paraphrase: A reader of the original language pointed to a sentence whose English changed or lost the meaning.
themes.did: Single reports are corrected on the page. The library-wide picture is measured against published translations, and the fixes it points to are in progress.

themes.label: The text belongs to another page
themes.paraphrase: The transcription or English beside a scan was the text of a neighbouring page, or repeated the page before.
themes.did: A screen of the whole library for text shifted one page against its image has run. The repair is open.
